_comment: 数据取得清单：仓库**不存**第三方数据文件，只存这份配方与 registry.yaml 里的 sha256 钉。
每条 bse 条目说明“从哪取（BSE 的 basis 名 + 元素）+ 转录成什么样（元数据）+ 期望摘要”。
qwb_studio.datafetch 按这份清单下载 → 用 qwb_studio.bse_data 转录 → qwb data sign 打戳 → 核对 sha256。
刻意用 JSON 而不是 YAML：Python 侧没有 YAML 解析器（project.md 2.4 不引入 PyYAML），
而这份清单必须是机器可读的；K1 的 data 文件仍然全是 YAML。
自研数据（functional/ grid/ examples/）不在本清单里 —— 它们是我们自己写的参数，随仓库一起走。

provider.name: bse
provider.note: Basis Set Exchange；§8.1 允许 BSE 导出，禁止从其他项目仓库复制文件

transcribe.name: sto-3g
transcribe.notes: Transcribed from the BSE export of STO-3G (revision 2018-06-19, 'Data from Gaussian09') for H/C/N/O/F; numbers are from Hehre-Stewart-Pople 1969, BSE used only as the export channel (project.md 8.1). STO-3G has max l=1, where spherical and cartesian functions coincide, so angular=spherical carries no ambiguity.

citations.title: Self-Consistent Molecular-Orbital Methods. I. Use of Gaussian Expansions of Slater-Type Atomic Orbitals

transcribe.name: def2-svp
transcribe.notes: Transcribed from the BSE export of def2-SVP (revision 'Data from Turbomole 7.3') for H/C/N/O; spherical d. Declared normalization=none on purpose: the exported contraction coefficients are NOT renormalized (measured <f|f> = 0.978 for C 1s under normalized primitives, the Turbomole convention), so the loader normalizes once at load time (project.md 8.1).

citations.title: Balanced basis sets of split valence, triple zeta valence and quadruple zeta valence quality for H-Rn (Weigend & Ahlrichs, PCCP 7, 3297, 2005)

transcribe.name: def2-tzvp
transcribe.notes: Generated by scripts/gen_basis_from_bse.py from Basis Set Exchange (revision: Data from Turbomole 7.3); never transcribed by hand. Declared normalization=none on purpose: the exported contraction coefficients are not renormalized, so the loader normalizes once at load time (project.md 8.1).

citations.title: Balanced basis sets of split valence, triple zeta valence and quadruple zeta valence quality for H-Rn (Weigend & Ahlrichs, PCCP 7, 3297, 2005)

transcribe.name: 6-311g(d,p)
transcribe.notes: Generated by scripts/gen_basis_from_bse.py from Basis Set Exchange (revision: Data from the Original Basis Set Exchange); never transcribed by hand. Declared normalization=none on purpose: the exported contraction coefficients are not renormalized, so the loader normalizes once at load time (project.md 8.1).

citations.title: Self-consistent molecular orbital methods. XX. A basis set for correlated wave functions (Krishnan, Binkley, Seeger, Pople, JCP 72, 650, 1980)

transcribe.name: lanl2dz
transcribe.notes: Transcribed from the BSE export of LANL2DZ (revision 2013-03-25) for H, O, Cu, Zn. ECP parameters (Cu, Zn only) live in qwb-data/ecp/lanl2dz-{cu,zn}.yaml. Cu keeps 3s3p in the valence (10 core electrons, Hay-Wadt K..Au paper); Zn uses the [Ar] core (18 core, Hay-Wadt Sc..Hg paper); H and O are all-electron LANL2DZ valence bases (Hay-Wadt Na..Bi paper). Declared normalization=none: the exported contraction coefficients are NOT renormalized (measured <p|p> = 2.87 for Cu 3p under normalized primitives), so the loader normalizes once at load time (project.md 8.1). License: BSE export; the original papers do not state explicit commercial/redistribution terms, so both flags are false per project.md 14 #20 (strict reading).

citations.title: Ab initio effective core potentials for molecular calculations. Potentials for K to Au including the outermost core orbitals

transcribe.name: def2-svp-ri
transcribe.notes: Transcribed from the BSE export of def2-SVP-RI (revision 'Data from Turbomole 7.3') for H/C/N/O; spherical. This is the Coulomb-fitting (RI-J) basis of the def2 family; the same set is used as the RI-MP2 auxiliary basis (SC-05). Declared normalization=none on purpose: the exported contraction coefficients are not renormalized, so the loader normalizes once at load time (project.md 8.1).

citations.title: Balanced basis sets of split valence, triple zeta valence and quadruple zeta valence quality for H-Rn (Weigend & Ahlrichs, PCCP 7, 3297, 2005)

transcribe.name: def2-tzvp-ri
transcribe.notes: Transcribed from the BSE export of def2-TZVP-RI (revision 'Data from Turbomole 7.3') for H/C/N/O/F; spherical. Coulomb-fitting (RI-J) basis of the def2 family, also used as the RI-MP2 auxiliary basis (SC-05). normalization=none on purpose (see def2-svp-ri). Contains g functions (l = 4): the spherical transformation currently stops at l = 3, so using this as an auxiliary basis is rejected explicitly.

citations.title: Balanced basis sets of split valence, triple zeta valence and quadruple zeta valence quality for H-Rn (Weigend & Ahlrichs, PCCP 7, 3297, 2005)

transcribe.name: def2-universal-jkfit
transcribe.notes: Transcribed from the BSE export of def2-universal-JKFIT (revision 'Data from Turbomole 7.3') for H/C/N/O/F; spherical. Joint Coulomb+exchange fitting basis for the def2 family (RI-JK, IN-04). normalization=none on purpose (see def2-svp-ri). Contains g functions (l = 4): see def2-tzvp-ri.

citations.title: Universal basis sets of Gaussian-type functions for the fitting of the Coulomb and exchange contributions (Weigend, PCCP 8, 1057, 2006)

transcribe.name: lanl2dz-cu
transcribe.notes: LANL2DZ ECP for Cu, transcribed from the BSE export (revision 2013-03-25). 10 core electrons ([Ne] core), so 3s/3p stay in the valence: the Hay-Wadt K..Au paper (10.1063/1.448975). Local channel = l=2 (the highest l in the export); l=0,1 are the nonlocal projectors. The valence basis is qwb-data/basis/lanl2dz.yaml (same family); K1 pairs them through Registry::load_pair. License: BSE export, the original paper states no explicit commercial/redistribution terms, so both flags are false (project.md 14 #20 strict reading).

citations.title: Ab initio effective core potentials for molecular calculations. Potentials for K to Au including the outermost core orbitals

transcribe.name: lanl2dz-zn
transcribe.notes: LANL2DZ ECP for Zn, transcribed from the BSE export (revision 2013-03-25). 18 core electrons ([Ar] core, 3d/4s in the valence): the Hay-Wadt Sc..Hg paper (10.1063/1.448799). Local channel = l=3 (the highest l in the export, an f channel); l=0,1,2 are the nonlocal projectors -- the d channel matters because the valence basis has d functions. License: BSE export, no explicit commercial/redistribution terms, both flags false (project.md 14 #20).

citations.title: Ab initio effective core potentials for molecular calculations. Potentials for the transition metal atoms Sc to Hg
